recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, cel-shaded illustration of a young man in a red techwear jacket whose face is fragmenting to reveal a glowing red robotic skull underneath. The disintegration effect features blue cable-like sinews and floating geometric shards against a clean, off-white background.
coreVisualRelationships: Contrast between the organic human skin and the mechanical red interior
Juxtaposition of the calm facial expression with the aggressive, screaming skull
Visual weight balanced between the peace sign hand and the glowing handheld device
Unified color palette linking the jacket, the skull, and the UI accents
coreInvariants: Off-white textured background with rounded border
Heavy black ink outlines with varying line weights
Triadic color scheme of red, blue, and yellow accents
Fragmented particle effect trailing from the right side of the head

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central medium shot, waist-up, filling approximately 70% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The red skull with glowing yellow eyes serves as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the human face, moves right to the disintegrating skull, follows the particles upward, then drops to the peace sign and across to the glowing phone.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample flat negative space surrounding the subject to emphasize the silhouette and detail density.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep red (jacket and skull) providing high energy and aggression.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Muted blue (internal wiring and shadows) providing cool depth.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant yellow (eyes, liquid drips, and device glow) for highlights.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the subject against a low-value, desaturated cream background.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid gradients; use flat cell shading

letterConstructionRules: Abstracted, futuristic glyphs that mimic technical data
characterSpecificRedesigns: Small-scale metadata text in the top left corner
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Mix of vertical technical glyphs with horizontal blocky sans-serifs.

preserve: Small scale relative to the subject

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the blocky, futuristic aesthetic of the jacket patches.
Provides a clean, tech-focused geometric feel for metadata.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a cel-shaded illustration of a man in a red techwear jacket, his face splitting open to reveal a red robotic skull with yellow eyes. Use heavy black outlines and a cream background. Include blue wires and floating shards.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add vertical futuristic glyphs in the top left corner and small geometric logo patches on the jacket chest using vector outlines.

verificationChecks: Ensure the skull is a vibrant red that matches the jacket.
Check that the disintegration particles flow towards the right.
Verify the presence of yellow liquid drips on the fingers.

adjustableVariables: Color of the internal robotic components
mustRedesign: Specific brand logos on the jacket
postGenerationChecks: Does the image maintain a comic-book aesthetic?
Is the contrast between the red skull and blue wires clear?
Are the yellow highlights (eyes/phone) sufficiently luminous?
Is the composition centered and balanced?
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Subject: Man in Techwear] + [Effect: Cybernetic Disintegration] + [Style: Cel-shaded Comic Art] + [Palette: Red/Blue/Yellow/Cream] to create a high-impact character portrait.
